messages:
Marco Ruiz: Quick kickoff note — Sable Systems EAP is officially green (NDA signed). We have a short preview window next Wed/Thu to validate perf + telemetry before the marketplace listing. Need volunteers for bench runs, telemetry checks, and a short write-up for the partner.
Anya Patel: Thanks — can we lock success criteria now? My suggestion: p95 latency <120ms @ 128 tokens on A100-class hardware, throughput >= X tokens/s at batch 8 for 512 tokens, and memory/instability regressions flagged automatically. Also want a qualitative note on output fidelity vs baseline.
Samir Khan: I can own the eval set + prompt suite. Which model family are we focusing on for the EAP? Sable mentioned two configs: 13B fp16 and a 7B int8-quant. Do we run both? Also recommend running sampling + greedy to catch edge cases.
Julie Park: I'll build the runtime images and quantization candidates. Quick Q: what CUDA/cuDNN baseline should we target? Sable lab nodes are on CUDA 12.4 per their doc but they can provision newer if needed. Also will add KV-cache warmup step to the script.
Devon Li: SRE notes: lab nodes are on a private VLAN — telemetry collector needs whitelist. Send me the ingest IPs and I’ll open egress for that CIDR only. Also propose we run a short CI job that reproduces the failing path before/after each benchmark so regressions are easier to triage.
Hana O'Neil: Legal: NDA is signed but we have one telemetry retention item outstanding — partner wants 90 days, we need partner to sign the deletion SLA for raw traces. I'll loop in their legal today.
Marco Ruiz: Plan outline —
- Wed morning: infra + image push (Julie + Devon)
- Wed afternoon: bench profile A (13B fp16) (Samir + Julie)
- Thu morning: bench profile B (7B int8) + stability sweep (Samir)
- Thu afternoon: data handoff + write-up draft (Marco + Anya)
Action items: Julie build images, Devon whitelist telemetry IPs, Samir prep prompts, Hana finalize telemetry retention clause.
Marco Ruiz: Bench command (dev-run) that we'll use (run inside the runtime image):
```
./bench-run
  --model llama2-13b
  --precision fp16
  --seq-len 2048
  --batch 8
  --iters 100
  --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.redwood.ai/ingest
  --kv-warmup 512
```
Julie Park: I'll attach the runtime image tag in the spreadsheet once build finishes. Also planning two kernel sets: cuBLAS-12 + cudnn-8 and cuBLAS-13 fallback. Will include a small script to toggle them.
Samir Khan: For metrics collection, let's capture: tokens/s, p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU memory high-water, and 99.9% per-request CPU usage. I'll add a small set of prompts that stress long context handling.
Devon Li: Whitelist IPs: 34.82.19.121 and 34.82.19.122 (telemetry ingesters). I'll add firewall rule and ping once done.
Hana O'Neil: Partner agreed to the 45-day retention compromise and signed the deletion SLA. They pushed a redline on crash dumps — we'll only collect anonymized stack hashes.
Anya Patel: Can we include a short customer-facing summary template? I can draft a 1-pager that marketing can use for the marketplace entry if the results look good.
Marco Ruiz: Perfect. I'll update the spreadsheet with schedule + add the bench job link. Please drop quick confirmations here when tasks are done. Also FYI Jordan from Sable confirmed they'll provide a thermal log stream and power profiles — we'll ingest that as supplemental CSVs.
ops-bot: bench-runner: new job queued: job_id=sb-20260324-01, scheduled start=1964796000
Samir Khan: Confirmed I'm good for both days; will push prompt set to the shared folder by EOD.
Julie Park: Image pushed: redwood-runtime:sable-eap-20260324-rc1 (link in sheet). Kernel switch scripts in /ci/artifacts.
Devon Li: Firewall updated and tested — can reach telemetry endpoint from lab. Ran a healthcheck: latency to ingest ~18ms.
Marco Ruiz: Thank you all. We'll sync briefly Tue 10am PT to walk the runbook and make sure nothing is blocked. :thumbsup:
